returns._0: The address of the bonding curves storage contract.

constructor.details: Constructor to initialize the bonding curve factory with the bonding curves storage contract.

params._bondingCurvesStorage: The address of the bonding curves storage contract.

createBondingCurve(string,string,bytes,b.details: it is recommended to use the FactoryManager helper function createBondingCurve(string, string, bool) instead of calling this function directly.

params.id: A unique identifier for the creator of the bonding curve. This is used in the frontend (emitted in an event) to distinguish between different accounts with the same wallet address. The id is either the FID (Farcaster ID) or the DID (Privy's Decentralized Identifier). If you want to skip this, you can pass an empty string or '0'.
params.isDevLocked: Whether the developer's address is indefinitely locked (until the token migrates).
params.metadata: The metadata of the token, which can include additional information such as description, image URL, etc. It is abi-encoded and includes (in this order): required - description, image URL; optional - Telegram, Twitter, Farcaster and Website.
params.name: The name of the token.

returns._0: The address of the newly created bonding curve contract.

createBondingCurveFor(string,string,byte.details: This function is intended to be called by the FactoryManager helper function createBondingCurveFor(string, string, address, bool) for you (see IFactoryManager).

params.id: A unique identifier for the creator of the bonding curve. This is used in the frontend (emitted in an event) to distinguish between different accounts with the same wallet address. The id is either the FID (Farcaster ID) or the DID (Privy's Decentralized Identifier). If you want to skip this, you can pass an empty string or '0'.
params.isDevLocked: Whether the developer's address is indefinitely locked (until the token migrates).
params.metadata: The metadata of the token, which can include additional information such as description, image URL, etc. It is abi-encoded and includes (in this order): required - description, image URL; optional - Telegram, Twitter, Farcaster and Website.
params.name: The name of the token.

returns._0: The address of the newly created bonding curve contract.

disable().details: This function can only be called by the owner of the factory.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bondingCurvesStorage().notice: The BondingCurvesStorage contract is a central contract that holds all the bonding curves, as well as the FactoryManager and other related data.

createBondingCurve(string,string,bytes,b.notice: Creates a new bonding curve and a BurnableToken, with the specified name and symbol. The msg.sender will be set as the developer of the token.This function can be called directly, or will be called by the FactoryManager helper function createBondingCurve(string, string, bool) for you (see IFactoryManager). In both cases, the msg.sender will be set as the developer of the BurnableToken.The function is payable, allowing the user to send Ether along with the transaction, for initial funding of the bonding curve.

createBondingCurveFor(string,string,byte.notice: Creates a new bonding curve and a BurnableToken, with the specified name and symbol. The developer's address is set to the provided address.The function is payable, allowing the user to send Ether along with the transaction, for initial funding of the bonding curve.

disable().notice: Disables the factory, preventing any further bonding curve creation.

isActive().notice: Checks if the factory is active.
